company.shortDescription: Hingeto build powerful crowd funding stores for great brands.
company.description:
Hingeto builds powerful crowd funding stores for brands. It develops and operates crowdfunding sites that let fashion brands test demand for new designs without having to produce them upfront. Payment methods such as Visa, MasterCard, Discover, and American Express are accepted at checkout. It provides products such as caps, ties, dresses, jackets, hoodies, accessories, and pillows.

Hingeto was founded in 2015.
